title: Fubini–Tonelli on the cylinder (0,1) × A ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} (supplied step 2(b)–(c))
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let A ⊆ ℝⁿ (Euclid n) be Borel. Write ι(t, u) := (t, u_1, …, u_n) ∈ ℝ^{n+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))), z_0 := WithLp.ofLp z 0, tail z := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) ∈ ℝⁿ, and Â := {z ∈ ℝ^{n+1} : z_0 ∈ (0, 1) and tail z ∈ A}. All measures are Lebesgue measure (volume). Then (a) Â is Borel; (b) for every Borel f : ℝ^{n+1} → [0, ∞], ∫⁻_Â f = ∫⁻_{u ∈ A} ∫⁻_{t ∈ (0,1)} f(ι(t, u)) dt du; (c) for every f : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ integrable on Â, ∫_Â f = ∫_{u ∈ A} ∫_{t ∈ (0,1)} f(ι(t, u)) dt du.
